note: Sizes and addresses were checked against the servers, not written from memory. A wrong size here is a progress bar that lies and a disk-space check that passes when it should not.

models.name: Qwen2.5 3B Instruct
models.note: The smallest that rewrites prose without breaking it. Measured on Italian: it keeps the meaning and the register, and answers a sentence in about a third of a second.

models.name: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct
models.note: The same size and speed as the one above, from a different family. Worth having if you prefer the way it writes.

models.name: Qwen2.5 7B Instruct
models.note: Better at long paragraphs and at holding a register, and slower in proportion. Wants around 8 GB of memory free while it runs.

models.name: Qwen2.5 0.5B Instruct
models.note: Half a gigabyte, to see the machinery work. Not good enough to write with: asked to make a sentence formal, it turned a commissioning test into a competition and invented a word. Kept in the list because it downloads in a minute and proves the rest is working.
